name: super
description: mindlace's Claude Code plugins: supersonic (superconductor + supercomposer), superpowers-jev (optional TypeSafe Jev judgments for superpowers), superpowers-html (superpowers specs and plans written as HTML) and superpowers-reader (shows a just-written spec or plan beside the chat).

plugins.name: supersonic
plugins.description: superconductor conducts a multi-spec build through named claude --bg operator sessions; supercomposer composes the package it executes.

plugins.name: superpowers-jev
plugins.description: Optional TypeSafe Jev typed judgments at superpowers and supersonic decision points. Shadow mode by default; fails open.

plugins.name: superpowers-html
plugins.description: Overlays superpowers 7.x so specs and plans are written as HTML in the supersonic spec format. Fails open.

plugins.name: superpowers-reader
plugins.description: Shows a just-written spec or plan (.html under docs/) in the desktop app's browser pane, styled by superspec's stylesheet. Needs Node; no install step; fails open.
